Lines.Line_01: The Earth's crust is divided into
Lines.Line_02: 15 major tectonic plates. These plates
Lines.Line_03: move at a rate of 1 to 2 inches
Lines.Line_04: per year. The Pacific Plate is the
Lines.Line_05: largest, covering 103 million square
Lines.Line_06: kilometers. Earthquakes often occur
Lines.Line_07: where these plates meet.

Lines.Line_04: the largest being the Pacific Plate.
Lines.Line_05: This plate moves at an average rate
Lines.Line_06: of 7.5 cm per year. The collision of
Lines.Line_07: plates can create mountain ranges.

Lines.Line_01: Aphelion is the point in Earth's orbit

Lines.Line_04: aphelion, Earth is approximately 94.5
Lines.Line_05: million miles or 152 million kilometers
Lines.Line_06: away from the Sun. This distance varies
Lines.Line_07: due to the elliptical shape of Earth's orbit.

Lines.Line_07: electrical storms.

Lines.Line_02: will not change its motion unless a force
Lines.Line_03: acts on it. For instance, a stationary
Lines.Line_04: object will stay still unless pushed.

Lines.Line_06: speed of 20 meters per second will

Lines.Line_08: a force changes its velocity.

Lines.Line_05: the wild, they can live up to 35 years.
Lines.Line_06: Silverbacks play a crucial role in their
Lines.Line_07: group, making decisions, and leading the
Lines.Line_08: troop to food and safety.

Lines.Line_07: by Dutch settlers for 60 guilders,
Lines.Line_08: equivalent to roughly $1,000 today.

Lines.Line_06: sick or injured pack members. They are known
